scope: Three new fairy-themed aquarium background image assets

files.name: 이슬 머금은 요정숲
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final illustrated background for Pongdang Island's aquarium game, ONE full-bleed continuous underwater panorama. Landscape, approximately 27:16 aspect ratio, high-resolution and polished.
Art direction: elegant softly painted fantasy illustration with refined natural materials, soft dimensional shading, delicate edges and restrained luminous details. Dreamlike and pretty, clean and readable; no heavy cartoon outlines, no plastic toy look, no photographic realism.
Composition: one coherent aquatic environment spanning three adjacent portrait phone viewports, NOT a triptych. Give left and right areas beautiful distinctive scenic accents, a connected low sandy floor, and generous quiet open swimming space across the middle and upper-middle. Keep the central 45 percent especially uncluttered. Major architecture and vegetation sit on the lateral margins and low side ledges. Clear translucent water, visible overhead underwater-surface refraction, soft caustics, layered depth. Small-scale details suggest a fairy world.
Constraints: this is BACKGROUND ONLY; actual fish and game creatures are added separately. No fish, no animals, no visible fairy characters, no people, no text or numbers, no labels or prices, no interface, no glass aquarium box, no border, no panels, no collage, no watermark. Do not fill the water with particles or extreme bloom; avoid dominant structures in the center.

Theme: 이슬 머금은 요정숲 — Dew-kissed Fairy Grove.
A serene submerged fairy woodland in fresh mint, pale jade and soft ivory. Gracefully curved mossy roots and translucent leaves frame the outer sides, with a few tiny mushroom cottages tucked into the left and right side ledges; round doors glow with very faint warm honey light. A few dew-like pearls cling to fine ferns near the floor, and small white woodland blossoms add restrained accents. Low warm cream sand, clear mint water and gentle filtered morning light. Distinctive and luxurious yet minimal. The central water remains broad, calm and empty; no giant central tree, no dense jungle. Render ONE complete final image.

Theme: 꽃잎 속 요정 궁전 — Fairy Palace within Petals.
A delicate submerged fairy palace in blush pink, pale rose, cream and pearl, with quiet pale aqua water for contrast. Organic magnolia-petal arches and a small graceful ivory pavilion on the far left, a low flower-petal balcony and curved pearly stairs on the far right. Asymmetrical airy botanical architecture, a few rounded pearls and tiny blossoms along the side floor; no imposing central palace and no forest of columns. Soft peach-white illumination through rippling water. Keep the central water spacious and uncluttered. Refined romantic fantasy, less glitter and fewer decorations, no giant crystals. Render ONE complete final image.

Theme: 달빛 잠든 요정 호수 — Fairy Lake Asleep in Moonlight.
An enchanted submerged moonlit lake in soft periwinkle, muted indigo, pale silver and a touch of teal. The surface above filters gentle silver moonlight into water, not a night sky. Silver-white water lilies and delicate crystal bellflowers grow on the low left and right ledges. A tiny crescent-shaped fairy garden pavilion rests far left, while a small silver stone wishing well nestles at the right edge, integrated into the aquatic garden. Smooth lavender-blue sandy floor, quiet clear blue middle water with enough brightness to see colorful fish added later. A very few faint light motes near the side flowers; no dense stars, no giant moon in the middle, no dark black abyss. Elegant peaceful nighttime fantasy with clear open central space. Render ONE complete final image.
